description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50. Summary Every large group in Europe has bought an AI assistant, or is buying one this year. The next decision is harder: how their teams' own work runs on agents, across their own systems, governed, on top of what they already pay for. That is what Dust sells, and this role owns that decision inside a handful of France's largest groups. You will be one of our first Strategic Account Executives. We are looking for people who have been at the top of every team they have joined, wherever they started. The Role 5 to 8 named groups, 5,000+ employees, mostly headquartered in France. You own each relationship globally, across subsidiaries and countries. Some are already customers. They started with one team and grow as more teams build their own agents. Their renewals are where your account grows, and you run them. The others you open. We go in through the executive who owns the group's AI programme, before any tender is written. Our founders and executives work your accounts with you, and so do the consulting firms that run these programmes. Deals of €300K to €1M+ a year, decided by the executive committee, with IT, security, procurement and the business in the room. You run the deal team: solutions engineers, customer success, partners and founders, brought in when you decide. You write the playbook. How Dust sells to large groups is being built now, by the people in this seat. What success looks like 90 days: an account plan for each group, the owner of the AI programme identified in all of them, and a first executive meeting held in at least half. 12 months: a first group-level deal signed, and one existing account growing across new teams. Who we are looking for You have been at or near the top of every team you joined. Tell us your rank in each role, and where you started. We care more about how far you have come than about the logos on the way. You have opened large accounts yourself, without a big brand or an inherited list doing the work. You have led a deal decided at executive level, with procurement and legal involved, and you can walk us through every step of it. You have grown an account after the first deal, and you think in what an account is worth in three years. You use AI in your own work. If you have built an agent, show us. Fluent French and English. Based in Paris or moving here, with regular travel in France and Europe. We do not screen on years of experience or on the size of your last employer. If you have been the best at what you did and want a bigger game, apply. What is hard Our brand is smaller than the labs'. You will win on what Dust does next to the assistant a group already chose, not on our name. Large groups move slowly and decide at the top. A unit that loves the product does not make a group deal; you will learn to find the person who does. The playbook is unfinished. You will be writing it while you use it. What you get OTE €180k OTE 50/50 split, uncapped accelerators, and a significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed company. Founders on your accounts, a small team that decides fast, and room to lead as the Strategic team grows. We are not promising a title; we will look here first when we need one. Health cover, relocation support, Paris office, regular trips to San Francisco. We have an office-first culture. description: L’histoire de Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd'hui, le compte représente : 20 M€ de chiffre d'affaires annuel en moyenne sur les trois dernières années, soit environ 20 % de l'activité de Theodo. 100 à 120 Theodoers, répartis dans une vingtaine d'équipes. Des projets variés : plateformes digitales, outils métiers, Data, Cloud et IA, dont la construction d'une usine agentique. La relation entre Theodo et Bpifrance entre dans une nouvelle phase, avec un contrat de trois ans en cours de finalisation et trois priorités : Développer le compte auprès de nouveaux interlocuteurs, notamment dans les métiers du financement, de l'investissement et de l'innovation. Élargir nos interventions, notamment sur les sujets Data et IA. Structurer les opérations commerciales pour mieux anticiper les besoins, piloter le staffing et suivre la performance du compte. Transformer les besoins identifiés en propositions commerciales, avec la KAM et les équipes techniques. Participer aux ventes de bout en bout : qualification, construction de l'offre, négociation et closing. 2. Piloter et développer ton périmètre client Devenir l'interlocuteur commercial de référence de plusieurs équipes Bpifrance. Anticiper les fins de mission, les prolongations et les nouveaux besoins en compétences. Structurer les opérations du compte Assurer un suivi fiable du pipeline commercial, des projets et des indicateurs financiers dans HubSpot. Améliorer les processus de staffing, de reporting et de coordination entre les équipes. Automatiser les tâches récurrentes et développer des outils internes avec l'IA. description: Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer. Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam krijg jij de kans om midden in de actie te staan. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze projectleider in de praktijk van energietransitie en energie-armoede. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over interventies: jij maakt impact. Dit wordt jouw stage Wil jij meedenken over een maatschappelijk vraagstuk dat steeds urgenter wordt? Tijdens deze stage duik je in het thema energiearmoede: wat is het precies, waar speelt het en wat betekent dit voor ons als organisatie? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede Wat ga je doen? Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn. Je houdt je bezig met: Het in kaart brengen van wat energiearmoede betekent; Inzicht krijgen in waar het speelt en welke doelgroepen geraakt worden; Gesprekken voeren met corporaties en marktpartijen (interviews, ophalen van ervaringen en data); Onderzoeken welke oplossingen er zijn, zoals passief bouwen, minder installaties of slimme energieoplossingen; Vertalen van jouw inzichten naar een duidelijke visie: waar moeten wij ons op richten en hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Het gaat hierbij niet om de techniek alleen, maar juist om de combinatie van sociale impact, marktontwikkelingen en strategie. Dit is jouw team Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam is een ontwikkelende bouwer met zo'n 220 enthousiaste collega’s. Wij zijn onderdeel van de Divisie Bouw en Vastgoed en herkenbaar in groen en geel. Onze ambitie is groot en met veel enthousiasme ontwikkelen en bouwen we gezonde en fijne leefomgevingen, waar mensen zich thuis voelen. Benieuwd waar wij ons mee bezig houden? Bekijk hier een paar van onze huidige projecten: Projecten Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam Dit bieden wij jou Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week; Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven; Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens; De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer; Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan! Dit breng je mee Je doet een hbo- of wo-studie in de richting van bouwkunde, built environment, duurzaamheid, technische bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare studie; Nieuwsgierigheid naar veiligheid in de praktijk, vooral in de bouwsector; Niet bang om je handen uit de mouwen te steken; Proactief, sociaal en je werkt graag samen, maar weet ook zelfstandig je weg te vinden; Beschikbaar vanaf februari 2027 voor minimaal 4 dagen per week. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze Campus recruiter! Want to see us in action? Joining the Mobile Platform team, you’ll work on the technical foundations that power the app — from architecture and shared libraries to core experiences, build systems, and analytics infrastructure. The Mobile Platform team does not own individual customer journeys or build product features on behalf of squads. Product teams remain responsible for their customer experiences and the services they own, including responding to incidents within those product-owned areas. Instead, your focus will be on creating and maintaining the shared capabilities, tooling and standards that enable those teams to deliver safely and effectively. While the app today is built with React Native, we are expanding our native capabilities in Swift and Kotlin and are transforming the Android experience with a move toward a more fully native approach. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of that journey! A day in the life: Reporting to an Engineering Manager within one of our teams. Play a key role in migrating the app from React Native to native Android, building in Kotlin with strong architectural foundations and industry best practices. Partner with the wider mobile engineering community, including React Native developers, to define best practices for native development and support engineers cross-training into native Android. Improve the performance, robustness, and overall quality of the app by identifying bottlenecks, addressing technical debt, and resolving defects to optimise the user experience. Customer-focused, with a genuine interest in Zopa’s mission. Added bonus: Experience applying mobile security best practices in production Android applications. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role We're expanding our protein expression into mammalian cell culture, for example in CHO and HEK cells. Our mammalian expression volume is growing fast. We're looking for a Cell Culture Engineer who has spent years growing and transfecting mammalian cells and knows what to do when a run goes wrong. You'll work alongside our production and mammalian cell teams as a hands-on expert in the cell culture lab. You'll keep cultures healthy and on schedule, run transfections and expressions, and be the person the team turns to when yields drop or cells misbehave. This is a hands-on role, not a management role. What You'll Do Run mammalian expression. Maintain, expand, and passage cell lines, and run transfections and expressions on a production schedule. Troubleshoot. When viability, growth, or yield falls off, find the cause and fix it. Own the cell bank. Thaw, freeze, and track cell stocks, and protect the lines from contamination and drift. Optimize conditions. Test culture and transfection conditions, and turn what works into the standard protocol. Scale with automation. Work with our automation team to move cell handling onto liquid handlers as volume grows. Hand off clean material. Deliver harvests ready for purification and downstream assays. Keep the lab running. Look after incubators, biosafety cabinets, and cell counters, and keep the BSL-2 space organized and compliant. Write SOPs and train. Document protocols that others can follow, and train the team on aseptic technique and our cell culture workflows. What We're Looking For Extensive hands-on experience with common mammalian model cell lines, for example CHO and HEK, including transfection and expression. BSc / MSc in biotechnology, cell biology, or a relevant field. A troubleshooting track record. You've rescued failing cultures and expressions and can explain what went wrong and why. Flawless aseptic technique and experience working under BSL-2 conditions. Experience with high-throughput formats: multi-well plates and many conditions in parallel, not only flasks. Experience with liquid handlers is a plus. Experience with antibody or Fc-fusion production is a plus. Organized and precise. You track every stock, passage, and transfection, and you follow protocols exactly. You use AI tools effectively and with discernment. We use them across the company and expect you to check, edit, and stand behind what they produce, not pass along unreviewed output. Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift. Cells don't keep office hours, so you plan around them. Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A, the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally. Your Role We are looking for a Chief of Staff – Corporate Affairs (f/m/d): the first point of contact and the engine room of our Corporate Affairs unit. You will report directly to our Chief Corporate Affairs Officer (CCAO) and run the day-to-day work that keeps a growing, cross-border agenda coherent and moving. This frees the CCAO to focus on relationships and strategy. You will own ambiguous, cross-functional execution independently. Strategic positioning and external representation remain with the CCAO. What You'll Do Own the CCAO's agenda and priorities, acting as her first point of contact internally and externally. Drive project management for Corporate Affairs initiatives across Brussels, Berlin, Hesse, and international markets, including tracking dependencies and milestones across locations. Run planning, OKR, and reporting processes for the unit on a reliable cadence. Build decision-ready briefings, talking points, and papers for senior management and the Board, prepared ahead of need. Prepare and follow up on meetings with government bodies, EU institutions, parliament, and industry associations. Partner with the CEO Office, Finance, Investor Relations, Legal, and technical teams on cross-functional initiatives. Manage relationships with external partners such as agencies and advisors. Enable rapid, coordinated responses to short-notice political and stakeholder developments. What You Bring Proven senior-level experience in chief of staff, executive support, corporate affairs, public affairs, or government relations roles. Solid understanding of political processes at federal, state, and EU level, and of public affairs fundamentals. Interest in energy and technology policy is a plus. Strong project management skills, with the ability to keep many cross-market threads moving without dropping details. Experience with OKR-based planning, stakeholder mapping, and cross-functional coordination, plus confidence with planning and project management tools. Clear, precise written communication in English and German, with a focus on decisions. You prepare materials that senior leaders and the Board can act on without rework. Ownership and initiative: you anticipate needs, flag issues before they are asked about, and take full accountability for the unit's execution. Sound judgment on operational decisions such as scheduling, sequencing, and partner management, with the ability to work without close supervision. Discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive political, regulatory, and Board-level information. Willingness to travel regularly to Brussels and Berlin. Nice to Have Experience in a scale-up or early-growth company. Experience in energy, fusion, or other deep-tech sectors. Experience with EU-level, parliamentary, or industry association engagement. Experience supporting a C-level executive in a cross-border organization. What We Offer Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery. Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you'll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career. Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges. Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company. Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together. Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year. Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily. Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives. Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1. Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace. Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs, whether it's a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing. You choose what fits your lifestyle. Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub. Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. description: About Octopus Energy for Business Octopus Energy for Business (OEB) is a rapidly scaling energy supplier with more than 130k business customers. In this role, you’ll take ownership of our business forecasting processes and lead the transition away from legacy, multi-tab spreadsheets. By leveraging modern data tools, you will build robust, automated pipelines to analyse margins, investigate variances, and provide actionable insights that optimise OEB's financial performance. You’ll collaborate closely with our Data team, finance teams, and senior leadership to ensure our financial strategies align with the company's sustainable growth objectives. What you'll do Provide consistent portfolio level reporting for OEB to determine overall net margins. This will include revenue, cost of sales, debt and operational expenditure. Improve accuracy of gross margin calculations in partnership with Finance and Pricing teams. Lead meetings with colleagues and senior management to provide clear options in the decision making process. Work closely with the pricing team to influence key decisions to ensure we provide customers with a wide range of tariffs which are set with a conscious view of outturned margins. Provide monthly reporting packs to monitor different aspects of performance including budgets and variance analysis. Work closely with business units to gather key inputs and assumptions for accurate forecasting. Improve the tools behind our forecasting, moving away from spreadsheet-heavy processes towards Python and SQL-based analysis. Compare forecasts with monthly actuals and thoroughly investigate variances across the business's book. A proven track record of untangling complex, legacy spreadsheet processes and replacing them with streamlined, automated solutions. Strong financial acumen, particularly with reporting margins, forecasting, and variance analysis. The ability to bridge the gap between commercial finance and data analytics, summarising complex findings into clear narratives for senior, non-technical stakeholders. description:
Who/What is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 2,000+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 26 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. At our German offices, we are on a rapid growth trajectory, advising leading national and international clients cross-industry on how to unlock the full potential of their data, build scalable data architectures, and implement cutting-edge AI solutions.

As a Consulting Manager (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy, you will act as a trusted sparring partner to executives, steer complex transformation programs across functions, and drive organizational change at scale.

 

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead AI Transformation Programs: Steer end-to-end execution of enterprise-level AI transformations. Identify internal champions, navigate corporate politics, manage structural blockers, and drive measurable user adoption and organizational change. 
  • Strategy & AI Use Case Scoping: Work closely with C-level stakeholders to answer high-stakes questions: How can AI reshape their business models? How should they govern data? You don't just advise; you help evaluate model choices, discuss data privacy trade-offs, and conceptualize technical feasibility.
  • Drive Business Growth: Actively drive the growth of our German practice. Take ownership in lead generation and pipeline conversion by engaging prospective clients, shaping proposals, and leading pre-sales and key-account expansion initiatives.
  • Thought Leadership & Advocacy: Represent Artefact's AI Transformation perspective externally. Advance our voice in enterprise AI through expert discussions, content creation (e.g. LinkedIn, whitepapers), and opinionated, hands-on perspectives on applied AI trends and real-world adoption pathways.
  • Advance the Practice: Evolve our methodologies, tools, and frameworks to keep our offering state-of-the-art. Develop reusable transformation playbooks and bring your strategic consulting or technology expertise into the team.
  • Team Leadership & Mentoring: Act as a senior advisor and role model - leading, coaching, and mentoring agile, hybrid project teams (consultants, data scientists, and engineers), fostering a fast-paced, “can-do” culture.

 

Candidate Profile

At our heart, we define ourselves by a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable talents who bring strong motivation and curiosity for new challenges. You are a true team player, eager to support others while scaling both the company and your own career.

  • Work Experience: You have approximately 5-8 years of full-time working experience in top-tier management consulting, technology consulting, or strategic corporate in-house roles. A proven track record of successfully leading and delivering data, analytics, or AI-driven transformation projects is essential.
  • Transformation & Change Management: Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation programs, with the ability to manage executive stakeholders, navigate corporate politics, and embed AI capabilities within client organizations.
  • AI Fluency & "Builder Mindset": Strong fluency in modern and applied AI (e.g., GenAI, LLMs, agentic systems, automated workflows). While you don't need to be a full-time programmer, you have a hands-on understanding and can credibly demo working AI concepts and discuss data privacy and technical constraints.
  • Analytical & Technical Acumen: Knowledge about common machine learning techniques, cloud architectures, and data management principles. Excellent quantitative skills to draw strategic insights from complex data sets.
  • Communication & Presence: Outstanding communication, presentation, and moderation skills. You have a strong presence and can translate complex technical topics into compelling arguments for non-technical senior executives, as well as bridge the gap to technical execution teams.
  • Education: Excellent academic track record with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, or a comparable quantitative field.
  • Languages: Business-fluency in both German and English (written and spoken) is mandatory to successfully advise our German clients and lead workshops. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Work Eligibility: A valid work permit for Germany.

 

Why Join Us?

  • Strategy with a Data Edge: Artefact sits uniquely at the crossroads of top-tier business strategy and deep tech. You will build boardroom-level strategy expertise while staying at the absolute forefront of AI, data management, and digital value creation.
  • Impact & Entrepreneurial Freedom: As part of a fast-growing team in Germany, you will have high visibility from day one. You will directly help shape Artefact's footprint in the region, bringing in your own ideas and driving business growth.
  • Continuous Learning: Constant exposure to new AI solutions at the intersection of technology and business. Access to regular training in both strategy consulting methodologies and the latest AI/data capabilities through our global network.
  • Culture of Doers: We combine a high degree of self-assurance with a supportive, collaborative environment. We are entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and committed to delivering real impact - while strongly supporting each other's personal growth.

 

This position is based in Berlin or Munich.

Don't worry if you don't meet all the criteria! At Artefact, we value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else.If you are excited about shaping the future of AI and ready to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity & Inclusion at Artefact > We believe that unique perspectives fuel innovation. At Artefact, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome and consider all applications purely based on merit, skills, and potential - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, age, background, or disability. Come as you are! 

Ready to take the next step? Please submit your CV showcasing your experience and passion for this role as a Consulting Manager (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy. We look forward to receiving your application!

description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact As Corporate Counsel, you’ll support Airwallex’s growth in the UK by providing practical, business-focused legal advice on corporate, regulatory and commercial matters. You’ll work closely with Corporate Development on strategic transactions such as fundraising and M&A, partner with UK and regional leaders on new-market entry, support licence expansion, and help align Airwallex’s global policies and governance with UK and relevant EMEA requirements. You’ll also advise on marketing, referral and partnership initiatives, helping the business move quickly while managing legal and regulatory risk. Provide clear, pragmatic advice on UK and relevant EMEA legal and regulatory requirements, helping teams navigate applicable rules while enabling responsible growth. Support Corporate Development on fundraising rounds and strategic transactions, including due diligence, data rooms, corporate approvals, investment documentation, cap table changes and ongoing governance. Partner with the business, Regulatory Legal and Regulatory Compliance teams on expansion into and launches in new markets across the UK and EMEA, including regulatory mapping, entity and licensing considerations, and corporate governance requirements. Align Airwallex’s policies, procedures and corporate governance frameworks across jurisdictions, with particular focus on UK requirements. Draft, review and negotiate referral agreements, marketing and sponsorship agreements, and other commercial arrangements, ensuring risks are appropriately managed and documented. Advise on marketing, advertising and promotions, including claims, disclosures, digital campaigns, co-marketing and referral programmes, while supporting the review of customer-facing materials for legal and regulatory compliance. Coordinate and manage outside counsel on specialised matters in the UK and across EMEA, ensuring advice is high-quality, cost-effective and aligned to Airwallex’s risk appetite and business goals. Use technology and AI-enabled tools, including templates, playbooks, contract lifecycle tools and knowledge bases, to increase the speed, consistency and quality of legal work. You’ll work from our London office three days a week. What we're looking for Essentials Qualification as a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales, or an equivalent qualification in another UK jurisdiction, and in good standing with the relevant professional body. Proven experience in financial services and corporate law, preferably gained at a fast-growing technology or fintech company and/or a top-tier law firm. Demonstrated interest in financial services regulation and the fintech industry, with willingness to go deep on payments, e-money, money services and related regulatory topics in the UK and EMEA. In-depth knowledge of, or strong familiarity with, the UK legal and business environment, including how UK legislation, FCA requirements and cross-border rules impact fintech and payments businesses. Proven experience drafting and negotiating corporate and commercial agreements, with strong written and verbal communication skills that make complex issues clear to non-lawyers. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Corporate Development, Finance, Product, Compliance, Risk and Marketing, across time zones. Demonstrated capability in managing and leading outside counsel, including scoping work, controlling costs and consolidating advice into clear recommendations. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a practical, business-oriented approach and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Preferred Experience supporting fundraising transactions, M&A or strategic investments, including due diligence and deal execution, ideally in a technology or fintech context. Prior in-house experience in a fintech, payments or broader financial services company, particularly one operating across the UK and multiple EMEA jurisdictions. Experience advising on legal issues related to marketing, advertising and promotions, including digital marketing, performance marketing, referral programmes and brand partnerships. Exposure to UK financial services regulatory frameworks, including the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000, the Payment Services Regulations 2017, the Electronic Money Regulations 2011, FCA rules and guidance, and applicable financial promotions requirements. Experience partnering with Regulatory Legal, Regulatory Compliance or licensing teams on market expansion initiatives and regulatory change. Comfort using technology, AI and legal operations tools to increase the speed and quality of legal work, for example playbooks, templates, contract lifecycle tools or knowledge bases. You'll thrive here if You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway. You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business. You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect. You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. Learn more about your team Legal sits at the heart of the decisions that shape how Airwallex grows. This team backs the builders transforming us into a generational financial company, working alongside product, sales, and business partners every step of the way. You'll help shape a global licensing footprint most fintechs wish they had, while keeping our brand and data architecture best-in-class for customers entering the agentic economy and its regulatory demands. The hard part is helping the business move fast on product, revenue, and new-market expansion without compromising the discipline that protects the moat. It's a team for lawyers, strategists, and licensing specialists with commercial instincts, sharp judgment, and an obsession with customer-first outcomes. If you want to guide executive decisions and help build the licensing, structure, and judgment behind what comes next, this is where legal has real leverage. At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive. What You'll Do Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people. Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do. Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source. Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business. Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence. Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge. Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question. Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake. Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us. Requirements What You’ll Need Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field. 5-8 years of data engineering experience, including real ownership of a lakehouse architecture rather than only delivering against someone else's. Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience is strongly preferred — OneLake, lakehouses, Delta tables, the SQL analytics endpoint, Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks, and semantic models in Direct Lake mode. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously. Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does. Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL, solid PySpark, and comfort building and orchestrating pipelines yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams. Practical understanding of Fabric capacity: how workloads consume it, how to spot what is burning it, and how to keep the platform inside its envelope. Experience leading engineers — formally, or as a technical lead who set direction and mentored others. A first step into people management is welcome if the technical leadership is already there. Proven integration experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, as well as APIs, flat-file landings, and change data capture from operational databases. Solid data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling and an understanding of how a semantic layer serves Power BI. Working knowledge of lineage, data governance, and access control in a cloud platform; exposure to Microsoft Purview is a plus. Interest or experience in the data foundations behind AI assistants — retrieval, knowledge graphs, and preparing data so that an agent can answer with it. Aerospace or another regulated industry is an advantage; so is experience in a start-up or scale-up. Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus. Who You Are You are an architect who never stops building. You have strong opinions about how a platform should be structured, and you earn the right to them by being in the code. When something breaks, you want to know why it was possible, not just how to patch it. You enjoy growing engineers, and you understand that leading a small team means doing the work alongside them. Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.

The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.

The impact you will have:

  • Lead and grow the team: Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Hire, coach and promote, and grow engineers into tech leads.
  • Make agentic development the default path: Shape how developers and AI agents author, validate and deploy projects, both inside the workspace and from the developer's own coding agent. Design the tools, skills and guardrails so agents get the same safety and auditability as humans.
  • Own the strategy and roadmap: Partner with Product and Design to set a multi-quarter roadmap for declarative deployment: agentic development, governed deployments and deployment history, enterprise CI/CD, and new resource coverage. Make the trade-offs explicit when the demand is larger than the team.
  • Raise the bar on execution and operational excellence: Run a predictable delivery process for a fast-moving, open-source product with frequent releases. Own reliability, on-call health, incident response and the quality bar for a tool customers depend on to ship to production.
  • Treat backward compatibility as a product feature: Lead engine and configuration migrations without forcing customers through a flag day, and communicate change clearly to customers, the community and field teams.
  • Lead across the platform: Drive alignment with the many platform teams whose resources and services the framework deploys, and with our sibling teams in Developer Ecosystem (SDKs, CLI, IaC provider, IDE). Make the whole toolchain feel like one product.

  • 3+ years managing software engineering teams, and 8+ years of software engineering experience overall.

Stand-out experience:

This role comes at a pivotal moment: Younited is moving to a market-standard, end-to-end FP&A organization and the Head of FP&A will be responsible for shaping his/her team target operating model, formalise scopes and ways of working, and progressively automate and strengthen the reliability of the whole planning and reporting chain — while partnering closely with the business to turn financial analysis into better decisions. Own the monthly closing process: pre-close anticipation of closing topics so that issues are spotted before the accounts are closed, post-close analysis of variances to budget, and capital plan. Deliver timely, clear financial reporting tailored to each audience — leadership, local management and business partners — including management accounts, variance analyses and ad hoc studies, and act as a business partner to the divisions on strategic initiatives and performance improvement. description: Health can’t wait. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Key Account Management Team Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+. We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe on Public Sector accounts (Ministries and other public entities). Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds. We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems! ⭐ Is it you we’re looking for? As a Key Account Manager, you will: Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts in the Public Sector Build and maintain strong customer relationships with key stakeholders and display a customer-centric approach to identify the main needs and allow our clients to achieve their goals through Alan Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them Ensure successful onboarding of new accounts and promote Alan health partner positioning to generate massive adoption by employees and admins Analyze and present consumption reports to customers through business reviews Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing customers Renegotiate contracts to guarantee both great value for money to our customers and sustainable profitability Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you: You have at least 6 years of experience in a customer-facing role including frequent interactions with C-Levels You have full working proficiency in French (excellent oral and written communication) You have at least advanced level in English You are experienced in dealing with very large organizations and potentially with unions You have the tact and empathy that make great negotiators You are an expert in positive lobbying with key stakeholders and create long-term relationship based on trust and transparency You are very analytical, very comfortable with presenting deep data analysis to clients and solving complex problems You have great active listening skills and are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market You are currently based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux or Marseille. It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits. Having experience with or within the Public Sector space is also a nice to have. For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-E level range. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary. Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Bordeaux or Marseille. All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits. Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture. Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents. Important note: we hire people, not roles. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register. We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🎯 Your main goal will be to land and expand n8n inside the world’s largest organisations, closing the biggest deals in our portfolio. As a Large Enterprise Account Executive covering Nordics & Benelux, you will own a territory of global-scale accounts and lead long, complex deals from first conversation to multi-year commitment: BUILD STRATEGIC ACCOUNT PLANS Build and execute account strategies for organisations with 5,001 or more employees Open doors with outbound campaigns aimed at CTOs, CIOs and engineering and platform leaders. Turn community adoption inside large companies into sponsored, funded opportunities. LEAD COMPLEX, MULTI-THREADED DEALS Run deep discovery, quantify business impact and build an executive-level business case. Map and align decision makers across engineering, IT, security, legal and procurement. Partner with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships and Customer Success to prove value and de-risk adoption. CLOSE AND EXPAND AT SCALE Own the cycle through security, legal and procurement, typically over three to six months or more. Negotiate six-figure deals with confidence and keep clear commercial control. Plan expansion across business units and use cases, and share what you learn with Product and leadership. REQUIREMENTS Must-haves 🏢 Large Enterprise sales: You have at least five years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, selling into organisations with 5,001 or more employees, and you can explain customer size, deal complexity and cycle length. 💰 Six-figure deals: You have closed multiple deals of £100k+ ACV in multi-stakeholder cycles of three to six months or more. 🧑‍💻 Technical buyers and executives: You have sold to developers, engineers, CTOs and CIOs, and you can carry a technical conversation and an executive one in the same deal. 🎯 New-logo hunter: You generate your own pipeline through outbound and win new customers rather than relying on expansion or inbound. 📈 Track record: You have consistently hit or exceeded quota over the past two to three years. 🧭 Structured selling: You use a methodology such as MEDDPICC and navigate technical evaluations, procurement, legal and security reviews. 📍 Location: You are based in the Nordics / Benelux. This role involves regular travel to customers in the region. Nice-to-haves 🛠️ Technical product background: You have sold developer tools, cloud infrastructure, data, AI or automation platforms. 🤝 Partner-led deals: You have worked deals with system integrators or cloud partners. 🚀 Open source or PLG exposure: You understand how community adoption turns into enterprise revenue. Why join us? You will close the largest deals in our portfolio and shape how n8n sells to the world’s biggest organisations, with a product technical teams already use and love. You will work closely with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships, Customer Success and Product, and leadership will listen to what you learn in the field. n8n is growing at an exceptional pace, backed by a vibrant community and a remote-first culture built on autonomy, experimentation and high talent density. Apply now and help us bring AI-powered automation to the global enterprise. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health & wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about. Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang. *Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement. This puts European industry under massive cost pressure – and companies need to act now. trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that brings together energy procurement, energy management and the marketing of flexible assets in one product. This helps companies save up to 30% on their recurring electricity costs while switching to renewable energy. We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast – the market window is open and we intend to own it. Now we are looking for an Operations & Strategy Manager to own a business-critical part of our energy value chain: the processes behind how we configure, price and quote long-term energy products for our customers. About trawa trawa is a tech-driven scale-up based in Berlin with around 100 employees, combining deep energy market expertise with in-house software development. We've raised over €35M to date, most recently a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic and Tiny VC. This role is based in our Berlin office, where we work together in person most of the week. We offer flexible working hours, so you can shape your day in a way that works for you. The Team You'll join our Energy & Trading team, which owns the energy side of our business – from sourcing and portfolio management to making sure our customers' energy products work in practice. You'll report directly to our Energy & Trading Manager and work closely with the COO, our Trading Team, Sales, Pricing, Product and Tech. You start without direct reports, but with a clear mandate: own our CPQ process end-to-end and grow the margin it generates. Business acumen & process mindset: You think commercially, care about margins and unit economics, enjoy turning messy processes into robust, scalable ones and prioritise by impact. Interest in energy markets: You are fascinated by how energy markets work – from wholesale and forward markets to PPAs, hedging and pricing – and want to dive deep into them. Knowledge of the German energy market is a plus; experience in (energy) trading is explicitly not required – what matters is your drive to understand the mechanics and make the processes behind them work. Hungry & ambitious: You want to grow fast, take on responsibility early and set high standards for yourself. You don't wait for instructions and enjoy a steep learning curve, and work experience in a high-paced environment, e.g. a start-up, scale-up or consulting, is a plus. High ownership & structured execution: You drive topics end-to-end, align stakeholders across departments and turn ideas into scalable processes with tangible business impact. An affinity for AI-powered tools and automation to make processes faster and smarter is a plus. Strong communication: You speak German at native level and very good English, and you translate confidently between commercial, quantitative and operational perspectives. What you'll do As Operations & Strategy Manager, you combine a strong analytical mind with process excellence and commercial drive: Own our CPQ process: You take end-to-end ownership of our CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) processes for long-term energy products – from the customer request through pricing and offer creation to trade execution, across Sales, Pricing, Trading and Operations and for all our customer segments. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden. De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn. Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf. description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.
  • Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.
  • Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.
  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.
  • Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.
  • Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.
  • The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.
  • Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.

Strongly preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.
  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.
  • Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.
  • Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.
  • A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers
  • Terraform
  • Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis
  • Vue and TypeScript
  • APIs and automation
  • DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance

What this role is not

This role isn't:

  • A generic field engineering role.
  • A proof-of-concept factory.
  • A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.
  • A customer-specific customization function.
  • Unbilled Professional Services.
  • A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.
  • An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures

Success in this role may include:

  • Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.
  • Fixing product bugs or contributing features.
  • Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.
  • Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.
  • Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.
  • Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.
  • Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.
  • Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.

About the team

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.

Ideal candidate profile

You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.

You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership.

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience. Many successful candidates don't meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply and let our recruiting team assess your application.

Security standards, policies, and design patterns library Security architecture review process Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work. To succeed in this role: You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. In addition, you have the following technical expertise: Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries Zero trust architecture principles Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) The following competence is desired: OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) Container and Kubernetes security Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease.
