description: About airSlate airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - SignNow, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work. We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines. At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment. We are looking for a hands-on leader to run Data Enablement. The team that owns how our data is modeled, trusted, and made ready for the business and for AI. You will lead analytics engineers and web analytics specialists, own the semantic layer end-to-end, and turn raw product and event data into curated, well-documented datasets that people can rely on. WHAT YOU WILL DO: Lead and grow the team. Set priorities, coach, and keep a steady delivery rhythm across analytics engineering and web analytics. Own the semantic layer. Design, build and evolve SQL-based models and metric definitions so that one number means one thing across all our products. Raise data curation and automate the routine. Move the team from ad hoc requests to reusable, tested, documented datasets that people and our AI data assistant can query directly, with tracking checks and data-quality monitoring on autopilot. Set standards and partner across the data organization. Modeling conventions, version control, testing and release practices, code review; work with Data Business Partners, Data Science / ML and Data Platform on scope and ownership. Stay close to the code on critical builds. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: Experience. 5+ years in analytics, data or BI engineering, including 2+ years leading a team or leading others technically. Expert SQL and Python. You set query and performance standards others follow, rewrite expensive queries and explain the trade-offs, handle incremental loads, deduplication and slowly changing dimensions, and own production Python components that other teams depend on. Data modeling and pipelines. You design warehouse and mart models that several teams build on, including a semantic layer, and choose the methodology (star schema, Data Vault or equivalent) to fit the queries it must serve. You optimize and troubleshoot pipelines on a cloud stack such as AWS (Athena, Redshift, Glue) and orchestration tools such as Airflow. Engineering discipline. You set branching and code review standards, require schema and data tests and CI before release, and lead risky changes with a clear rollout and rollback plan. Data quality and data fluency. You design validation that catches problems before stakeholders do, fix root causes rather than symptoms, set documentation standards, and investigate unfamiliar sources before trusting them. Business impact. You design solution options for complex problems, split cross-team work into pieces with a clear definition of done, build dashboards around the decision they support, and become a trusted partner to business leaders. AI in everyday work. You redesign team workflows around AI tools to drive adoption, and evaluate AI outputs for quality, privacy and bias. Leadership and ownership. You own complex team-level projects, make high-impact decisions from complex information, coach people by spotting skill gaps and giving regular feedback, set clear scope expectations, and turn change into actionable steps for the team. Communication. You clarify complex ideas, build consensus across teams and time zones, and communicate in fluent English. Nice to have: experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework (we may adopt one); web analytics and tracking (GTM, GA4); B2B SaaS or document-workflow / e-signature background. What we offer Flexible working environment - Our teams operate across the globe. We value in‑person collaboration in our hubs, but we also embrace remote and hybrid working. You can work from one of our offices in the United States, Poland, Romania or Ukraine, or remotely from many countries. Competitive compensation and stock options - We offer salaries that reflect local market conditions and experience, plus a performance-based bonus system and stock options so you share in the company’s growth. Professional growth and learning - We invest in your development through courses, conferences, and access to learning resources. We encourage career growth and internal mobility, supporting teammates who want to explore new opportunities within airSlate. Health and well‑being - We provide comprehensive benefits tailored to each country, including health coverage, wellness programmes and access to fitness options. We also dedicate quarterly company-wide Mental Health Days, when everyone takes time off to rest and recharge. Family‑friendly culture - Family life is part of who we are, and we embrace it in many forms. From flexibility for parents to our airSlate Junior Club for kids, to company-wide family days and our pet-friendly approach, we’re committed to making work and life easier to balance. Giving back - We support charitable initiatives around the world through the airSlate Care programme. Our current focus includes humanitarian aid in Ukraine and other regions, matching employee donations and supporting causes chosen by our teams. Open communication - We encourage transparent dialogue at all levels. From team discussions to company-wide Q&A sessions with our CEO, we make sure everyone has the chance to be heard and to influence how we grow. Somos una compañía tecnológica latinoamericana que trabaja junto a empresas de diferentes partes del mundo, creando soluciones digitales innovadoras, escalables y de alto valor. Nuestra cultura combina excelencia técnica, colaboración, aprendizaje continuo y una fuerte orientación a las personas. La Inteligencia Artificial forma parte de nuestra manera de trabajar, innovar y resolver problemas. Buscamos incorporar nuevas tecnologías para construir mejores productos y potenciar las capacidades de nuestros equipos. Si te apasiona la tecnología, disfrutás resolver desafíos complejos y querés participar en proyectos donde tu trabajo tenga impacto, nos encantaría conocerte. Sobre el rol Estamos buscando un/a Data Engineer Semi-Senior con experiencia práctica en Neo4j, Cypher y modelado de datos en grafos para sumarse a un proyecto innovador de LegalTech enfocado en transformar la manera en que se organiza, conecta y consulta información legal, tributaria, contable y regulatoria. Vas a participar en el desarrollo y evolución de un Knowledge Graph que permitirá relacionar grandes volúmenes de información, identificar conexiones semánticas y potenciar soluciones de búsqueda inteligente basadas en Inteligencia Artificial. Esta posición combina Data Engineering, Graph Databases e Inteligencia Artificial, con un fuerte enfoque en la construcción de soluciones productivas, escalables y mantenibles. Trabajarás junto a equipos de Data Science, Backend e IA para transformar modelos conceptuales, taxonomías y ontologías en estructuras de grafos eficientes que alimenten arquitecturas de recuperación de información como RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Buscamos una persona con una base sólida en ingeniería de datos, experiencia real trabajando con Neo4j y motivación por seguir desarrollándose en Knowledge Graphs, búsqueda semántica y GraphRAG. ¿Qué vas a hacer? Modelado de grafos: Diseñar, implementar y mantener modelos de datos en Neo4j, representando entidades, relaciones, jerarquías y estructuras complejas de información. Ingeniería de datos: Construir y optimizar pipelines ETL/ELT para ingesta, transformación, validación y actualización de datos estructurados y no estructurados. Desarrollo con Cypher: Crear y optimizar consultas complejas para recuperación de información, navegación de relaciones y procesamiento de datos en grafos. Implementación de Knowledge Graphs: Transformar taxonomías, ontologías y modelos conceptuales definidos por Data Science en estructuras productivas dentro de Neo4j. Integración con IA y RAG: Participar en la integración de Neo4j con embeddings, búsqueda vectorial y arquitecturas de recuperación semántica. Optimización de performance: Mejorar consultas, estrategias de indexación, consistencia de datos y escalabilidad de la base de grafos. Integración con Backend: Desarrollar integraciones mediante Python o Node.js para conectar los datos del grafo con aplicaciones, APIs y servicios internos. Calidad de datos: Implementar validaciones, controles automatizados y buenas prácticas para garantizar la integridad y confiabilidad de la información. Trabajo interdisciplinario: Colaborar con especialistas en Data Science, Inteligencia Artificial y desarrollo de software para evolucionar la arquitectura de datos. ¿Qué buscamos? Experiencia: Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia profesional en Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering o posiciones similares. Neo4j: Experiencia práctica diseñando, implementando y manteniendo soluciones basadas en bases de datos de grafos. Cypher: Buen dominio del lenguaje para desarrollar consultas complejas, recorrer relaciones y optimizar operaciones sobre grafos. Modelado de datos: Conocimiento de modelos Property Graph, nodos, relaciones, labels, propiedades y buenas prácticas de diseño. ETL/ELT: Experiencia desarrollando pipelines de ingesta, transformación e integración de datos. Programación: Manejo de Python o Node.js para procesamiento de datos, automatización o integración con servicios. Optimización: Conocimiento de índices, constraints, optimización de consultas y performance de bases de datos. Arquitectura de datos: Capacidad para transformar requerimientos funcionales y técnicos en modelos de datos escalables y mantenibles. Fundamentos de IA: Familiaridad con embeddings, búsqueda semántica, bases vectoriales o conceptos de RAG. Autonomía y colaboración: Capacidad analítica, resolución de problemas, documentación técnica y buena comunicación con equipos interdisciplinarios. Será un plus Experiencia con Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG o arquitecturas de recuperación híbrida. Conocimiento de Neo4j APOC, Graph Data Science (GDS) o Neo4j Vector Index. Familiaridad con tecnologías semánticas como RDF, OWL, SKOS o SHACL. Experiencia integrando Neo4j con LangChain, LlamaIndex u otros frameworks de IA. Experiencia con Neo4j AuraDB, despliegues cloud o entornos contenerizados. Conocimiento de NLP, extracción de entidades, procesamiento documental o enriquecimiento semántico. Familiaridad con Kafka, RabbitMQ o herramientas de procesamiento distribuido. Experiencia implementando pruebas automatizadas sobre grafos, validaciones de calidad de datos o herramientas de observabilidad. Experiencia previa en proyectos de LegalTech, RegTech, compliance o plataformas de gestión de conocimiento. ¿Qué te ofrecemos en Darwoft? description: Signicatis a pan-European digital identity company that makes it easy and safe for organisations to know who they are interacting with online. Using our proprietary technology, we help companies and public organisations securely verify the identities of people and businesses, authenticate users, and enable compliant electronic document signing, so their customers can access services and complete online processes with confidence. Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale. Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world. About the Role Imagine a software development environment where AI agents can collaborate, plan complex tasks, write code, run tests, and help engineers turn ideas into working software. That's what we're building. As a Platform Engineer in Signicat's AI Foundations team, you'll help design and build our internal AI Software Factory: a platform that enables teams of autonomous AI agents to work together, interact securely with our systems, and accelerate how we build software. This isn't just about integrating LLM APIs. We're building the foundations for agent-driven software engineering, tackling challenges around orchestration, distributed execution, state management, sandboxing, security, and human-agent collaboration. Our platform runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes, with Go as our primary programming language. You'll join a team exploring the boundaries of what's possible with AI agents, combining experimentation with solid software engineering principles to turn ambitious ideas into reliable, production-ready systems. How You'll Make An Impact Build the AI Software Factory: Design and develop the core services, APIs, and infrastructure that enable AI agents to plan, execute, and collaborate on complex software engineering tasks. Orchestrate intelligent agents: Build systems that coordinate multiple specialized agents, manage dependencies, schedule work, and support long-running, asynchronous workflows. Design reliable agent runtimes: Develop secure, stateful execution environments that manage agent lifecycles, context, tool invocations, retries, recovery, and execution isolation. Make autonomous execution safe: Implement sandboxing, fine-grained permissions, and security boundaries that allow agents to interact with code, tools, and internal systems without compromising security. Connect agents to the real world: Integrate LLMs, development workflows, internal APIs, and external tools through secure, extensible interfaces and emerging standards such as MCP and A2A. Enable human-agent collaboration: Help create systems where engineers can guide, supervise, and collaborate with autonomous agents, maintaining control over important decisions. Shape the future of AI engineering: Evaluate emerging technologies, challenge existing approaches, experiment with new architectural patterns, and help define how autonomous software engineering evolves at Signicat. Solve interesting engineering problems: Apply your understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, fault tolerance, and software architecture to challenges that don't always have established solutions. Why We'll Love You You have strong software engineering experience, ideally with Go, and enjoy building robust backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. You're comfortable working with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure, ideally on Google Cloud Platform. You think beyond individual services and understand how to design systems that handle concurrency, failures, asynchronous execution, and complex state transitions. You care about clean architecture, well-designed APIs, maintainable code, and automated testing. You understand the importance of security, particularly around authentication, authorization, isolation, and executing untrusted workloads. You're curious about LLMs and autonomous agents, including concepts such as tool calling, context management, multi-agent collaboration, and agent orchestration. You enjoy exploring emerging technologies, experimenting with new approaches, and turning promising ideas into practical solutions. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership of challenging technical problems, and helping shape architectural decisions. You enjoy sharing knowledge, collaborating with others, and challenging assumptions to find better solutions. Bonus Points You've built systems using agent frameworks such as Google ADK, or worked with protocols like MCP or A2A. You have experience with sandboxing or workload isolation technologies such as gVisor, WebAssembly, or container-based execution environments. You've worked with event-driven architectures, workflow engines, distributed schedulers, or systems supporting long-running processes. You've experimented with AI coding agents, autonomous development workflows, or multi-agent systems. You have experience designing secure integrations with external services, including OAuth and delegated authorization. You've explored graph-based architectures, RDF, SPARQL, or event-driven systems, and are excited about using these concepts to model complex relationships, agent workflows, and dynamic, reactive applications. This is a wish list, not a checklist. You don't need to have worked with every technology or built AI agents before. If you're a strong engineer who loves solving complex problems and is excited about shaping the future of AI-driven software development, we'd love to hear from you. What we offer: Tailored benefits package by location - we aim to empower our employees by offering customised benefits suited to each market Your tech, your way - choose the tech gear that aligns with your comfort and meets your preferences Remote work style -while you embrace a remote environment, we support occasional in-person gatherings to strengthen the teamwork Work-life balance - enjoy an extra 5 paid days off annually, and we make sure to celebrate your work anniversaries to acknowledge the milestones you achieve Health & Wellness - we prioritise your physical and mental well-being by providing designated packs and access to the Headspace app Continuous growth - quarterly development talks, a dedicated time during working hours each week for training and development, access to Udemy courses, defined career paths, and internal mentorship opportunities Customised onboarding - we will prepare an Onboarding Plan to ensure an easy and smooth beginning Be part of an international team - the opportunity to work from any other Signicat office for 2 months per year and 3 weeks per year from any EU country Empowering feedback culture - by using employee engagement tools, we ensure that every voice is heard, empowering us to grow together Meet-ups - frequent office gatherings and biennial Kick-off event to bring every Signicat under one roof that you don’t want to miss Salary: €70,000-€90,000 gross yearly. We are open to discussing the salary based on your skills and competencies. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Are you passionate about building robust data architectures that power next-generation, AI-driven business intelligence? Do you thrive in the intersection of data engineering and analytics, wearing both hats to design scalable backends and deliver actionable insights? We are looking for a Senior Marketing Analytics Manager - Business Intelligence & Data Architecture to join our Marketing Analytics team. In this role, you will work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Data Engineering teams to build the foundational "Gold Layers" and semantic models that enable self-serve reporting and agentic AI workflows. This is a great opportunity for a highly technical analyst who is hands-on with Python, Databricks, and SQL, and is excited about creating the infrastructure that enables AI for BI. If you’re energized by the challenge of bridging the gap between raw data pipelines and advanced analytical outputs, we’d love to hear from you. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. In this role, you will: Act as the bridge between Data Engineering and Marketing Analytics, designing, building, and maintaining robust ETL pipelines and "Gold Layer" tables in Databricks. Develop and document semantic layers, data dictionaries, and markdown files designed specifically to train and enable AI agents for scalable, self-serve BI. Develop dashboards and analyses to surface business-critical KPIs and assess sales and marketing performance. Perform ad-hoc reporting and deep dives to uncover key insights across programs and initiatives to inform strategy and decision making. Partner with marketing stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable data models and analytics-ready datasets. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Minimum requirements for the role: Bachelor's in Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Economics or other related analytical fields. 5+ years of relevant analytics, business intelligence, artificial intelligence or data engineering work experience. Expert in SQL, python, DBT and visualization platforms (Tableau preferred). Hands-on experience working with Databricks (or similar lakehouse architectures) to transform and model large datasets. Experience building data backends, semantic layers, and structured documentation optimized for AI ingestion and agentic workflows. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with experience in data analysis. Comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate data transformation, analysis, and visualization workflows. Experience supporting Sales, Product or Marketing teams. An ideal candidate also has: Experience building interactive applications using Streamlit or Claude workflows. Experience building web applications Experience working in web analytics Sales and marketing experience including familiarity with MarTech tools. Navigate large, multifaceted datasets to answer hard questions — drawing on the right analytical or statistical approach for each problem. Data Science, machine learning or predictive analytics experience. Actively builds AI fluency relevant to BI and analytics work, including prompt engineering for data tasks, exploring AI-assisted features in tools, and staying current on how AI is reshaping the analytics landscape. Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies. The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. Annual Base Salary $119,000—$180,000 USD Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Welcome to Brightline! We are searching for a Community Engagement Lead to join our BrightLife Kids team and drive outreach across the entire San Francisco Bay Area. You have the exciting opportunity to be a critical part in advancing the mission of the partnership with Brightline and the Children and Youth Behavioral Initiative (CYBHI). The State of California selected Brightline — out of more than 450 vendors — to provide free virtual behavioral health services to families with children ages 0–12. This program, BrightLife Kids, launched January 1, 2024, and offers a modern, easy-to-use digital experience with live coaching, personalized resources, parent peer communities, and local referrals — all at no cost to families or the community. As a Community Engagement Lead, you will be driving the adoption of BrightLife Kids across complex community ecosystems. This is a high-autonomy role designed for a professional who thrives on building high-level partnerships and influencing public health strategy. You won't just execute an established plan; you will proactively identify opportunities, contribute to program design, and serve as a primary thought partner to senior external stakeholders. You will also spend time out in the field, interacting directly with families and communities looking for behavioral health support. Explore our impact: Website: brightlife.kids/ca Instagram: @brightlifekids LinkedIn: linkedin.com/showcase/brightlife-kids/ Responsibilities: Strategic Marketing and Partnership Strategy: Develop comprehensive outreach and marketing strategies tailored to the specific demographics, cultures, and ethnicities of the target county. Create a partnership strategy that fosters mutual referrals, positioning BrightLife Kids as a valuable resource within the community. Build and nurture long-term relationships with senior external partners, including county health officials, school district leadership, and executive directors of major community-based organizations Operate with significant autonomy, managing a regional portfolio and presenting comprehensive updates and strategic recommendations at key milestones. Community Outreach and Engagement/Health Education/Health Promotion: Develop and adapt outreach and marketing strategies that span diverse and complex ecosystems, ensuring programs resonate across multiple stakeholder types Proactively identify service gaps and market opportunities; contribute to the design of new assets and engagement tactics Leverage existing networks and research methods to identify contacts within the target county, utilizing platforms such as Google, LinkedIn, and school district websites. Navigate and persuade varied audiences—from grassroots community groups to executive-level public health boards and School and Office of Education Boards —to align on shared goals for child mental well-being. Field Marketing and Event Participation: Lead and participate in high-visibility activation in-person events, online webinars, and school fairs, acting as a respected advocate for the BrightLife Kids mission. Provide informative materials and engaging discussions to educate parents about the importance of child mental well-being and the services offered by BrightLife Kids. Distribute branded swag and conduct webinars or in-person sessions to increase awareness and engagement. Performance Tracking and Reporting: Track key metrics related to outreach, engagement, and conversion rates. Regularly report progress, insights, and recommendations to manager, marketing team and upper management to inform decision-making and optimize strategies. Leverage Salesforce as primary CRM tool Collaborative Improvement: Continuously gather insights from engagement efforts and incorporate feedback to quickly enhance outreach and marketing strategies. Identify opportunities for new assets and content to address evolving needs, particularly in nurturing long-term relationships. Requirements: Bilingual proficiency in Spanish is highly preferred Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience in community engagement, public health, health promotion, or a related field Proven experience with Salesforce or similar CRM tools to manage a partnership pipeline and track outreach performance. Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage complex projects, and lead initiatives with minimal day-to-day managerial oversight A deep understanding of communication strategies and proven expertise in engaging specific demographics, cultures, and ethnicities. Experience navigating public and community health and school-based systems to build programs and gain adoption within the community Excited to be recognized as a respected advocate for child mental well-being within the community. Experience in cold outreach, relationship building, and developing high-touch nurture campaigns. Proficiency in utilizing online platforms and research methods to source contacts and gather relevant information. Strong organizational skills and the ability to track and report on performance metrics and use data to inform decisions. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal. Comfortable with public speaking and event participation. Demonstrates a proactive growth mindset and high level of agility, with a proven ability to pivot quickly in a fast-paced environment and embrace feedback Knowledge of pediatric mental health, early childhood development, public or community health, community needs and related services is a plus. Must be based in California and have reliable transportation This role often requires evening and weekend hours Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs, able to stand extended periods (4–6 hours), and attend outdoors in-person events and conferences in various weather conditions We offer several benefits, perks, and stipends: Medical, Dental, Vision, Long-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Flexible Spending Account, and 401k 14 Company Holidays, paid time off, paid sick days, parental leave Health and Wellness Stipend and Professional Development Reimbursement At Brightline we have built a total rewards philosophy that includes fair, equitable, competitive, geo-based compensation that is performance and potential based. Our strategy is based on robust market research, including external advisory specializing in national compensation, and thoughtful input from every level of our organization. It is a combination of a cash salary, equity, benefits, wellbeing, and opportunity. In compliance with the Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the annual base salary range for applicants is $78,000-$90,000 + language premium (if applicable) & performance bonuses. Our Commitment to Building a Diverse, Equitable, and Inclusive Workforce At Brightline, we believe that Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging are essential to the foundation upon which our mission is built. We are committed to: building a future where all families can access inclusive, high-quality care creating an environment that encourages our employees to show up authentically, reach their highest potential, and have an equal opportunity to thrive systematically evaluating and improving our inherent beliefs, observed behaviors, structures, and systems ensuring that every employee, candidate, client, and family we serve is valued and respected About Brightline Brightline is a therapy and psychiatry practice that delivers expert pediatric, teen, and parental mental health care to families and kids up to age 18. Brightline’s virtual and in-person outpatient services include diagnostic evaluation, therapy, psychiatry services (e.g. medication management), and psychological testing (to assess learning differences, school readiness, executive functioning difficulties [e.g. ADHD], and autism). In addition to Brightline’s generalized support, we offer focused programs including those that support anxiety, obsessive compulsive disorders, ADHD, and disruptive behaviors. Founded in 2019, Brightline has delivered care to tens of thousands of families with industry-leading results. We’ve been nationally recognized for clinical excellence and innovation for several years — recent awards include the Fast Company 50 Most Innovative Companies (2022) and Behavioral Health Business Companies to Watch Award (2024). Brightline is based in Palo Alto and is backed by investors including Boston Children’s Hospital, Northwell Health, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Massachusetts, Google Ventures, KKR, and Oak HC/FT.

description: About Juniper Square Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. About your role Sitting within Corporate Marketing, the SEO & AEO Manager owns Juniper Square's visibility across organic search, AEO, and GEO: how we're found, ranked, and cited, in traditional search and in the AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) that GPs and fund operations teams increasingly use to research vendors and ideas. Working across the broader GTM organization, you'll set the strategy, then own execution end to end, from technical foundation to AI visibility to authority building. GPs come to Juniper Square for software, for fund administration services, or increasingly both, and each entry point carries its own nuance (terminology, competitive set, audience expectations, etc.) so your strategy has to flex across the full platform rather than run one generic playbook. AEO and GEO add another layer: there's no industry-established playbook yet, and you're expected to help write one for Juniper Square rather than just execute someone else's. The right candidate uses AI as standard infrastructure and pairs technical rigor with the discipline to build processes that compound over time. The application deadline for this role is October 5th, 2026. What you’ll do Own Technical SEO Success here means organic traffic and rankings grow measurably against a defined set of priority terms across Juniper Square's full platform. Own SEO across junipersquare.com: on-page optimization, site architecture, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, and regular technical audits, partnering with our web engineering agency to scope and ship fixes. Monitor and improve sitewide crawl efficiency and indexing. Manage structured data (JSON-LD) and emerging AI crawling protocols, including llms.txt and plain-text/markdown alternates of priority pages. Own the brief and quality bar for agency and vendor relationships across SEO, AEO, and content production, deciding what stays in-house. Monitor Juniper Square's rankings against named competitors, in both traditional search and AI answer engines. When a competitor overtakes us on a priority term, diagnose why and drive the fix, whether that's a technical change, a content update, or an authority play. Win Citations Across the Open Web Success here means Juniper Square gets cited by name in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Google AI Overviews for the private markets questions that matter, tracked against named competitors. Optimize content for LLM and AI-search visibility: schema and structured data, answer-first formatting, and semantic reinforcement that makes Juniper Square content easy for AI systems to extract and cite. Extend that visibility beyond junipersquare.com to Reddit threads, YouTube (titles, descriptions, chapters, and metadata built to rank in video results), review sites, and other community content LLMs treat as trusted sources, and direct that content to work for two readers at once, crawlers and humans, using AI-assisted workflows to scale production without lowering the quality bar. Contribute to the broader social content strategy, including LinkedIn, so format and structure support search and AI-citation goals across channels, not just engagement. Run controlled experiments to isolate what actually moves AI citations rather than treating AEO as guesswork, and turn what you learn into a repeatable playbook. Track how AI platforms retrieve, summarize, and attribute Juniper Square content, report regularly on citation share alongside organic traffic and rankings, and use that data to reprioritize the roadmap. Treat technical SEO and GEO as one program with shared priorities instead of running them as separate workstreams. Build Category Authority Success here means referring domains and citations from private markets and financial media keep growing: real evidence Juniper Square is gaining authority on private markets ideas, not just its own product terms. Build Juniper Square's authority on the ideas that define private markets, not just on product and brand terms, so we're the source search engines and AI systems point to on GP operations, fund administration, and other core private markets topics. Tailor authority-building work to how a GP is engaging us, whether that's software, fund administration, or both, since the competitors and publications that matter shift with the entry point. Partner with content and subject-matter experts to identify where Juniper Square should be the definitive answer to a private markets question but isn't yet, and close those gaps. Qualifications 5+ years in SEO, including hands-on ownership of a technical SEO program at a large B2B organization. Real, hands-on AEO/GEO experience, not just familiarity with the concept. You should be able to point to a specific citation you've earned in an AI answer engine and explain exactly how you did it. A track record of earning backlinks and media citations built on original research or data, not outreach templates alone. Experience with SEO/GEO tooling, including rank trackers, log-file analysis, and AI-citation monitoring platforms. description: About Sayari: Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv. About the Role Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do. The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard. You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it. Why This Role Exists Customers buy answers. Superconductor reasons like an expert analyst at machine scale. The analyst’s job shifts from producing every answer by hand to directing, validating, and extending what Superconductor produces, and teaching customer analysts to do the same. Context should survive the contract. The analyst who designed the proof-of-value knows why the success criteria are what they are. Keeping that analyst on the account protects delivery quality and surfaces the next problem before the customer names it. Tradecraft is built in the field. Field Intelligence Analysts see what was promised, what was delivered, and what the customer did with it. That full view produces better methodology, better evals, and a better Superconductor than any single-phase role can. What You Will Do Own the analytical relationship, end to end Run discovery and proof-of-value engagements anchored on work the customer already pays people to do, such as alert adjudication, due diligence, investigations, and case prioritization. Define success criteria you will personally be accountable for delivering. Stay on the account after close and deliver the work you scoped. This includes multi-hop investigations across ownership, trade, and corporate records, plus analytical briefings and training. Serve as the customer’s single analytical point of contact from first conversation through renewal. Build with Field Engineering and Product Pair with FDEs on discovery and delivery. You define the analytical requirement, they build it, and you validate it against the mission. When something built for one customer should be rebuilt for many, make the case to Product with evidence: the problem, the workaround, and the customers who share it. Document where the platform falls short of the mission, with raw examples attached. Deliver analyst-plus-AI, and teach it Direct Superconductor against live mission problems. Validate its reasoning against expert standards, and extend it into new customer workflows. Train and certify customer analysts on Sayari methods and on working with Superconductor. Identify the customer experts who should go further. Build the tradecraft Capture the judgment calls, non-obvious pivots, and creative approaches from live engagements. Contribute them to the Tradecraft team as expert-annotated reference cases, eval scenarios, and training material. Hold your work to the Field Intelligence standard, and help raise it. Support Go-To-Market Teams Work with Sales to diagnose customer problems, scope solutions, and deliver mission impact. Who You Are Required A builder’s temperament and comfort with ambiguity. You do well on small teams with end-to-end ownership and no defined lane, working next to engineers on things that don’t exist yet. Experience conducting complex, multi-source investigations in one or more of these areas: financial crime, sanctions and export controls, supply chain and forced labor risk, transnational criminal organizations, or law enforcement and intelligence investigations. This should include work with corporate records, trade data, and OSINT. Customer-facing range. You have scoped engagements, demonstrated capability to skeptical experts, and delivered under a statement of work. Candidates often come from solutions consulting, services delivery, embedded analytics, or mission-support roles. Hands-on fluency directing and evaluating AI and agentic analytical tools. You can define what “right” looks like precisely enough to test against. Clear communication with analysts, program managers, engineers, and executives. Desired Python or SQL for data manipulation, and familiarity with REST APIs. Experience designing training curricula or certifying analysts. For government portfolios: an active Government security clearance and same citizenship as your country of residence. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

description: About Energy Exemplar In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation. Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include: SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards. Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards. IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards. How We Work Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move. We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role. Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together. About the Position The Director of Cloud Architecture & Delivery builds and leads the cloud architecture and forward-deployed engineering capability that enables Energy Exemplar's Solutions (pre-sales) organization to win and launch cloud-hosted and AI-enabled customers. This role builds and leads a team that works directly with customers to design, integrate, deploy, and validate cloud solutions and AI agents in customer environments. The position sits at the intersection of four disciplines: enterprise cloud architecture (Azure-first, multi-cloud fluent), energy-market software (PLEXOS, Aurora, Adapt2, and the PLEXOS Intelligence layer), applied AI and agentic systems, and consultative pre-sales. Utilities, ISOs/RTOs, developers, and regulators look to the Director for how Energy Exemplar's platform and AI agents run securely and at scale alongside their own cloud estates. The role owns the technical cloud and AI deployment in every pursuit: reference architectures, security and compliance responses, proof-of-concept environments, and the delivery plan that turns commitments made during the sales process into a practical, successful cloud and AI onboarding. The Director reports to the Vice President, Solutions (Americas) and sits within the Presales Solutions team. Partnering with Sales, Solutions, and Services, the Director shapes solutions for complex opportunities, leads technical conversations with senior customer stakeholders, and builds confidence in proposed architectures. The role works day to day with Sales and Account Directors, Solutions Engineers, Product and Engineering (PLEXOS Cloud and PLEXOS Intelligence), Post Sales Services, Customer Success, Information Security, and cloud platform partners to establish repeatable approaches to technical discovery, solution design, and validation, guide cloud migration and deployment planning, ensure a clear, practical handover into post-sales delivery, and build internal architectural expertise through coaching, enablement, and technical standards. It is a remote, United States-based Director-level position, a people-leader role that still expects individual-contributor depth, with travel of up to 30% for onsite customer meetings, executive briefings, and industry events across North America and LATAM. Key Responsibilities Build and lead a forward-deployed engineering capability that works closely with customer technical and business teams to translate priority use cases into deployed solutions. Embed with customer teams, on site and in their cloud tenants, to design, integrate, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows built on PLEXOS Intelligence, including integration with customer data, enterprise systems, APIs, and Energy Exemplar products. Act as the senior cloud and AI technical advisor to customers and prospects (utilities, ISOs/RTOs, IPPs, and consultancies), engaging CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and IT leaders to build confidence and resolve technical objections. Partner with Sales and Pre Sales on technical deal strategy, architecture workshops, and demonstrations; scope and guide proofs of concept and pilots with clear success criteria, from environment build and data onboarding through executive readout. Define acceptance criteria with customers and validate deployed agents and solutions against the agreed success criteria (accuracy, performance, security, and human-in-the-loop controls), with evidence customers can take to their governance and risk teams. Own the cloud reference architectures for PLEXOS Cloud, PLEXOS Intelligence, and adjacent AI agents and products as deployed for customers: landing zones, identity and access, networking, data residency, high-performance compute for large nodal and stochastic runs, and cost models. Lead the pre-sales-to-Services handoff for cloud and AI deals: deployment plan, architecture decision record, risk register, and onboarding timeline agreed with Post Sales Services before contract signature. Develop migration roadmaps and delivery estimates with Services and Engineering, documenting assumptions, risks, and responsibilities before commitments are made, and provide architecture oversight for complex implementations so the proposed solution carries through to delivery. Set guardrails for agentic deployments in regulated environments: agent identity and permissions, tool-use boundaries, evaluation harnesses, observability, and audit trails. Lead cloud and AI architecture input into RFIs, RFPs, security reviews, vendor risk assessments, and proposals, coordinating specialist input and ensuring responses are accurate and achievable; lead customer discussions on SOC 2, ISO 27001, NERC CIP adjacency, FedRAMP-equivalent expectations, and CEII handling, and maintain a current response library with Information Security. Establish reusable discovery frameworks, technical materials, agent templates, and deployment patterns (SaaS, customer-tenant, hybrid), including integration with customer data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Fabric, on-prem SQL) and API/automation patterns for model orchestration, plus runbooks and environment-as-code templates that make repeatable launches the default. Partner with Product Engineering to turn repeatable customer implementation patterns into supported product capabilities, reusable integrations, and deployment assets. Skills and Experience 12+ years in enterprise technology, including 7+ years designing and delivering production cloud architectures for enterprise or regulated customers in large or mid-sized organizations. Experience leading engineers embedded in customer implementations (forward-deployed, field engineering, or customer-embedded delivery teams), taking AI and data solutions from use case to production while managing customer expectations, scope, and handover. Strong customer-facing pre-sales experience supporting complex enterprise software opportunities, including technical discovery, solution validation and RFI or RFP responses. Deep expertise in at least one hyperscaler (Azure preferred) and working fluency across AWS and GCP: compute (VMs, Kubernetes, batch/HPC), storage, networking, identity (Entra ID, SSO/SAML/OIDC, SCIM), and managed data services. Experience designing AI agent engineering in production, including LLM application and agent orchestration frameworks, retrieval and tool integration, evaluation and monitoring, and model governance. Ability to connect architecture decisions to customer business objectives, commercial value and delivery feasibility, including cost and risk considerations. Strong understanding of enterprise integrations, REST/GraphQL, APIs and data flows, alongside cloud performance, scalability, governance and cost optimization. Executive presence, communication and the ability to lead architecture and risk conversations with CIOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and procurement at utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and developers. A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. Desirable Experience Master's degree in a technical or business discipline (MS, MEng, MBA) or equivalent demonstrated senior-level experience. Current professional-level cloud architecture certification: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or Google Professional Cloud Architect. Working knowledge of the North American power sector: ISO/RTO market structures (PJM, MISO, ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE), utility IRP and transmission planning cycles, and the data-governance expectations that come with CEII and market-sensitive data. Direct experience with energy market simulation, production cost, capacity expansion, or resource adequacy tools (PLEXOS, Aurora, PROMOD, GridView, EnCompass, or similar), or with ETRM platforms such as Adapt2. Experience migrating on-premises, compute-intensive analytical software to cloud or SaaS delivery, including customer change management and license-model transitions. Experience building or scaling a pre-sales architecture capability and supporting cloud adoption across enterprise customers. Measures of Success Strong technical win rates and effective resolution of architecture and security objections in supported opportunities. Proofs of concept meet agreed success criteria and help customers make informed decisions. Proposed solutions are feasible, well documented and handed over clearly to delivery teams. Reusable architectures and enablement improve pre-sales efficiency and technical capability. Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential. This Candidate Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you apply for a role with us.

description: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. Reporting to the Principal Counsel, Director of Commercial and Healthcare this role will serve as Lead Counsel, Commercial & Marketing for APAC and the Americas and be a key member of Oura’s Legal Team. The role will partner closely with the APAC and US Commercial, Sales, Partnerships, Retail and Marketing teams, along with other cross-functional leaders, to support Oura as the company grows and scales internationally.The ideal candidate is a seasoned commercial lawyer with substantial in-house and law firm experience advising on and negotiating complex B2B sales, strategic partnerships, data and technology licensing, and retail and distribution arrangements across APAC. Beyond commercial transactions, the right candidate will have hands-on experience advising marketing teams on advertising, promotions and consumer-facing campaigns in Asia and ANZ, including markets with distinct regulatory regimes such as Singapore, Australia, Japan, South Korea and China. The successful candidate will bring strong judgment, credibility with senior stakeholders, and the ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, actionable guidance in a fast-paced, evolving environment What You Will Do: Review, draft and negotiate complex commercial agreements as the lead lawyer supporting the APAC Commercial and Marketing functions, including enterprise and corporate sales agreements, B2B and channel partnerships, strategic alliances, co-marketing arrangements, and data sharing and licensing agreements. Structure and negotiate retail, distribution, reseller, marketplace and e-commerce agreements across APAC markets. Counsel and advise stakeholders on legal issues affecting APAC business, supporting alignment, efficiency and excellence in execution of commercial and marketing initiatives. Serve as a strategic thinker who helps shape company-wide risk strategy while driving key initiatives and applying a solutions-focused approach. Operate as a hands-on practitioner, comfortable managing high volumes of complex transactions. Build and refine internal transactional and marketing review processes, templates, playbooks and tools that can scale efficiently with company growth. Act as a trusted advisor to senior executives, providing clear, business-oriented judgment and actionable recommendations. Coordinate with US Legal, Privacy, Product and outside counsel in key APAC jurisdictions to deliver consistent global positions adapted to local law, and manage outside counsel where local qualification is required. This is a remote role based in the US. What you'll bring 8+ years of combined law firm and in-house PQE, with at least 4 years supporting commercial transactions and marketing in a consumer products, consumer technology, digital health, or retail business. Qualified and admitted to practice in at least one major common law jurisdiction (e.g. US (any state), Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia or New Zealand). Admission in a US state and/or an APAC jurisdiction is preferred. Experience working with local counsel in non-common-law markets in Asia is expected. Working knowledge of competition law as it applies to distribution and retail arrangements across the US and APAC, including vertical agreements, selective distribution and resale price maintenance. Deep working knowledge of US and APAC consumer protection, advertising and e-commerce frameworks, with the ability to apply them pragmatically to business objectives. Exceptional drafting skills, with experience negotiating and preparing sophisticated sales, partnership, technology and data licensing, and distribution and retail agreements. Familiarity with APAC and US privacy and data protection regimes as they apply to marketing, partnerships and data sharing, including structuring data use rights and restrictions in commercial agreements. Proven ability to identify and mitigate legal and regulatory risk while enabling scalable, innovative go-to-market models across multiple markets. Strong judgment and comfort operating as a trusted advisor to senior business stakeholders in a fast-moving environment. Clear, practical communicator who can translate complex legal issues into actionable guidance. Excels at working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with a track record of efficient business support. Nice to have: Fluency in an additional Asian language (e.g., Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Hindi) is a plus. Benefits At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. description: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! Why this role matters: Our Customer Success Training Specialist will provide the foundational learning for our Customer Success teams. In this role you will be the architect of the CS journey, from the moment a new CSM joins to the mastery of our post-sales ecosystem. Your key responsibilities: End-to-End Onboarding: Design and lead a world-class onboarding program that gets new CSMs up to speed on our product, our customers, and our unique approach to partnership Continuous Enablement: Develop post-onboarding curricula that keep the team sharp on new feature releases, industry trends, and advanced account management strategies ; including expansion positioning from upselling and cross-selling Needs Assessment: Identify knowledge and skill gaps through data-driven assessments, aligning all training programs to revenue priorities and business objectives Blended Learning Delivery: Develop and deliver engaging learning experiences - including live workshops, virtual sessions, and eLearning - for global CS teams of all experience levels Tactical Content Creation: Build practical exercises, job aids, and visual guides that translate technical API capabilities and product updates into actionable "Success Plays" Tools & Stack Mastery: Serve as the subject matter expert for the CS toolset (Gong, Salesforce andPlanhat,ensuring the team navigates our systems with speed and precision Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with CS Leadership to drive accountability and partner with Sales Enablement to ensure cohesive product and process updates across the revenue org Advocacy & Improvement: Serve as a trusted advisor and champion for continuous improvement in CS skills, processes, and training best practices. What you’ll bring: To be successful in this role, you should be a blend of an educator, a strategist, and a Customer Success advocate. We are looking for someone who understands that CS is both an art and a science. Required: CS Enablement Background: 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success training and enablement. If you’ve previously carried a book of business as a CSM, that’s a major plus The "CS Lens" on Sales Process: A solid understanding of the B2B lifecycle. You understand how discovery, handoffs, and pipeline management directly impact long-term retention and expansion. CS Tech Stack Power User: High proficiency in Salesforce and Planhat (or similar CS Platform such as Gainsight, Totango, Hubspot, Zendesk, and Churn Zero etc.). You are comfortable being the "go-to" expert who helps others navigate our tools with speed and precision Instructional Design Mastery: Experience creating clean, professional training materials, slide decks, and tutorials. Proficiency in Articulate (or similar authoring tools) is required to build our eLearning library Strong Facilitation Skills: You are a confident, engaging presenter who can break down complex API capabilities or process-heavy workflows into simple, actionable steps. Experience we consider a plus: Cross-Functional Collaborator: Ability to work effectively with Sales/CS Ops, Product Marketing, and CS Managers to ensure content is technically accurate and relevant to the field Detail-Oriented & Precise: A passion for accuracy and a "get it right" mindset when documenting internal processes and system workflows Strategic Advisor: A champion for continuous improvement who isn't afraid to identify skill gaps and propose creative solutions to fill them Methodology Knowledge: A background in MEDDPICC or similar sales/success methodologies is a significant advantage. Where you will work: This position offers a fully remote work arrangement based out of Spain. Sponsorship is not available. Legal authorization to work in Spain is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. #LI-HB There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you. To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice. Who we are: Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today. Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

description: About the Company Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense. With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud. Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world. About the Role We're looking for a Senior Field Marketing Manager to plan and execute Armada's field marketing programs across EMEA. This hands-on operator will turn regional business priorities into high-impact events and campaigns that generate pipeline, deepen executive relationships, and strengthen Armada's presence in priority markets. This role is highly execution oriented. You'll personally manage programs from brief through follow-up, spend significant time in market and on site, and partner closely with Sales to turn premium experiences and integrated campaigns into measurable business outcomes. Location Dublin, Ireland What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities) Regional Strategy and Pipeline Translate the annual EMEA field marketing plan into a detailed calendar of programs, campaigns, owners, milestones, target accounts, and follow-up actions aligned to territory priorities and pipeline goals. Execute integrated regional campaigns across events, executive programs, account-based marketing, digital, content, and partner channels to engage priority accounts throughout the buyer journey. Create market-specific programs that reflect local business dynamics, cultural nuances, and customer needs while maintaining a consistent global brand and narrative. Own regional performance reporting, including pipeline sourced, revenue influenced, account engagement, progression, and cost per outcome; use insights to optimize the portfolio continuously. Events and Executive Engagement Personally plan and deliver Armada's EMEA field event portfolio, including the Sovereign AI Tour, executive dinners, roundtables, roadshows, third-party conferences, partner activations, and customer programs. Own each program from brief through execution and follow-up, including audience strategy, invitations, registration, venue and vendor coordination, content, speakers, staffing, on-site delivery, lead capture, and post-event action plans. Create executive-tier experiences that convene senior customers, prospects, partners, and industry leaders around the issues shaping sovereign AI, infrastructure, energy, and security. Partner with the Dublin Experience Center team to develop customer briefings and regional executive programs that accelerate strategic opportunities and deepen relationships. Evaluate third-party event investments against audience fit, business relevance, brand alignment, and expected return; recommend where Armada should participate, sponsor, speak, or decline. Cross Functional Leadership Work side by side with EMEA Sales teams to build target lists, drive attendance, prepare account teams, run on-site engagement, and ensure timely follow-up against shared pipeline outcomes. Partner with Product Marketing, Corporate Marketing, Communications, Partnerships, Customer Marketing, and Experiential Marketing to bring campaigns and launches to life in the region. Build regional enablement plans so Sales and executive teams have the messaging, target lists, follow-up motions, and content needed to convert engagement into opportunity. Work with content and creative teams to capture customer stories, executive perspectives, photography, and video that extend the value of each program beyond the room. Budget and Operations Own day-to-day budget management for EMEA field programs, including estimates, purchase orders, invoices, accruals, reconciliations, and forecast updates. Manage agencies, venues, production partners, and other vendors, including selection, negotiation, scopes of work, timelines, and quality control. Build and maintain program briefs, workback plans, run-of-show documents, staffing plans, attendee communications, and post-program reporting for every activation. Travel to and lead programs on site, resolving issues quickly and maintaining a high bar for the customer, partner, and executive experience. Required Qualifications 10+ years of B2B field marketing, demand generation, or experiential marketing experience, ideally within high-growth enterprise technology or infrastructure companies. Proven success building EMEA programs that generate pipeline, engage senior decision-makers, and advance complex enterprise sales cycles. Deep experience partnering with regional Sales leaders and account teams to translate territory plans into focused marketing programs. Strong event and executive engagement expertise across multiple EMEA markets, from intimate C-suite programs to major industry conferences. Data-driven approach to planning and measurement, with fluency in pipeline reporting, attribution, account engagement, and budget optimization. Excellent project management and communication skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional workstreams and manage multiple programs at once. Sound judgment, executive presence, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities. Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40 percent across EMEA and internationally, including frequent multi-day trips and on-site event delivery. Preferred Qualifications Experience marketing AI, cloud, data center, energy, defense, or other complex infrastructure solutions. Experience with executive briefing centers, customer advisory boards, partner marketing, or account-based marketing programs. Existing agency, venue, media, or industry relationships across priority EMEA markets. Experience working at both a scaling startup and an established enterprise technology company. You're a Great Fit if You're A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you Equal Opportunity Statement At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive.
